StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack adds unconditionally, which is what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236 -- no StackType branch). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

BeforeCombatStart.issue: Identical shape to GalvanicPower's, one card type over (Skills rather than Powers, Tainted rather than Galvanized): the sim adds a `card.affliction is None` test that VitalSparkPower.cs:33-38 does not have, where C#'s CardCmd.Afflict overwrites. Same mechanism, same verdict (rule 3), same dormancy -- GalvanicPower afflicts the disjoint Power-card set and nothing else afflicts at combat start. Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AfterCardEnteredCombat.rationale: `card.Affliction == null && card.Type == CardType.Skill` (VitalSparkPower.cs:43) maps exactly to powers.py:2432.

AfterCardPlayed.rationale: `cardPlay.Card.Affliction is Tainted` -> `PowerCmd.Apply<TaintedPower>(..., cardPlay.Card.Owner.Creature, base.Amount, null, null)` (VitalSparkPower.cs:49-56) maps to powers.py:2437-2441. Note the applier is `null` in C# AND omitted in the sim -- the one place in half B where omitting it is CORRECT, and worth recording next to the units where it is not (high_voltage, territorial, crab_rage, ravenous, suck).

AfterRemoved.issue: C#'s AfterRemoved clears every Tainted affliction on EVERY removal path (VitalSparkPower.cs:58-77, guarded by `oldOwner.CombatState == null`); the sim hangs the same sweep on `on_death` filtered to the owner (powers.py:2451-2460) and then calls `self._expire()`. So the afflictions survive any removal that is not the owner's death -- and, symmetrically, they are cleared on a death where C# would only clear them because the death strips the power. DORMANT, and the two halves currently cancel: the sim never strips powers on death (content-power-report-b.md section 3c) so death is the only removal route in practice, and monsters/hive/infested_prism.py never removes this power by hand. Trigger: a hand removal of Vital Spark, or wiring ShouldPowerBeRemovedAfterOwnerDeath's default. Same shape as BurrowedPower's inlined AfterRemoved. Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AfterPowerAmountChanged.issue: C# re-syncs every Tainted affliction's Amount to the power's new Amount from `AfterPowerAmountChanged` with a `power != this` guard (VitalSparkPower.cs:79-98), so it fires on ANY amount change -- a stack, a decrement, or an Unsettling-Lamp-doubled application. The sim folds the sync into `on_stack` (powers.py:2443-2449), which cmds.py:311 calls only on the re-application path. Consequences: a DECREMENT of Vital Spark leaves the afflictions at the old amount in the sim; and the sync runs before `hooks.on_power_amount_changed` (cmds.py:312) rather than after. DORMANT: nothing ports a Vital Spark decrement (`grep VitalSparkPower` outside powers.py finds only monsters/hive/infested_prism.py's single application), so on_stack is the only reachable amount change. Third-file citations, not hashed here.

guards.rationale: Single-player equivalent. The Play-pile omission (player.py:100-103 vs PlayerCombatState.cs:70-80) is live-shaped for the on_death sweep -- the owner usually dies inside a player card play -- but the identical question was EXECUTED on power/hex, whose AfterRemoved sweep DID reach the in-play card, so it is recorded as checked rather than assumed here.
